purpose: v8 operational sealed BLIND runtime audit. Runner verification ends at RELEASED_RUNNER_VERIFIED_SCHEDULER_AUDIT_PENDING; external bhist/bacct capture is separately required.

inputs.job_spec_sha_rule: The future independent PASS review binds the actual final-job SHA-256; this immutable contract never contains a circular final-job digest.

post_run_scheduler_audit.terminal_claim_rule: Only a separately captured scheduler-audit artifact may claim RELEASED_VERIFIED.

receipt_schema.pass_failure_code_rule: PASS uses JSON null; this schema literal is not a lifecycle digest or unresolved value.
receipt_schema.runtime_label_rule: UNIQUE requires exactly one matched attempt with a nonempty measured wall_s. Timeout/nonzero attempts with wall_s remain chargeable; every no-wall attempt is MISSING_RUNTIME.

lifecycle.draft_rule: DRAFT_NO_EXECUTION is not submit-able and contains no final digest.
lifecycle.finalization_rule: The final contract binds the final template SHA-256 and implementation-freeze commit, but neither final artifact hashes a future receipt, job spec, review, or itself. Security boundary is CLI_ONLY_TRUSTED_PROCESS: same-user Python imports and direct filesystem reads are outside scope; source readers still fail closed for accidental/import misuse unless activated by the one-shot runner.
